description: This file contains unit tests for the InvokeCommandRegistry component in the ai.openclaw.app.node package. It tests the advertised capabilities and commands based on various feature flags and verifies the behavior of the registry's command lookup function.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the advertised capabilities and commands provided by InvokeCommandRegistry based on various configuration flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Test that the advertised capabilities include core features and exclude optional features when default flags are used.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Test that enabling specific features results in the advertised capabilities including these optional features.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verify that core commands are included and optional commands are excluded based on default flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Check that enabling features results in the inclusion of optional commands and debug commands.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Ensure only supported motion commands are included based on motion-related flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Verify the separation of SMS send and search capabilities in advertised commands based on flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Check that SMS capability is included if either send or search path is enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Verify that call log commands are excluded when call log feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Verify that call log capability is excluded when feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Ensure voice wake capability is advertised even if commands are not.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Test that querying the registry for camera-related commands returns correct foreground metadata.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verify that querying for a non-existent command returns null.
